question: A Cisco IMC on the Cisco UCS C-Series Server must be configured with VLAN ID 110 and a priority value of 20. Which command set meets these requirements?
options:
Server# scope cimc -
Server /cimc # scope vlan -
Server /cimc/network # enable vlan
Server /cimc/network *# set vlan-id 110
Server /cimc/network *# set vlan-priority 20
Server /cimc/network *# commit

Server# scope cimc -
Server /cimc # scope network -
Server /cimc/network # set vlan-enabled yes
Server /cimc/network *# set vlan-id 110
Server /cimc/network *# set vlan-priority 20
Server /cimc/network *# commit

Server# scope cimc -
Server /cimc # scope network -
Server /cimc/network # switchport mode trunk
Server /cimc/network *# switchport trunk native vlan 110
Server /cimc/network *# spanning-tree portfast
Server /cimc/network *# copy run start

Server# scope cimc -
Server /cimc # scope network -
Server /cimc/network # switchport mode access
Server /cimc/network *# switchport access 110
Server /cimc/network *# spanning-tree portfast
Server /cimc/network *# copy run start
theory: Configuring VLAN tagging for Cisco IMC's own management network on a C-Series server is done under 'scope cimc' > 'scope network,' where 'set vlan-enabled yes' turns tagging on before 'set vlan-id' and 'set vlan-priority' assign the VLAN and its 802.1p priority; there is no 'scope vlan' sub-scope, and switchport-style IOS commands (switchport mode trunk/access) don't apply to the Cisco IMC's own CLI, which is why the network-scope 'set vlan-enabled'/'set vlan-id'/'set vlan-priority' sequence is the correct configuration set. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 12 — Cisco IMC Network Configuration, VLAN Tagging)
